'''Wu Lizhu''' ({{zh|s=吴骊珠}}; born 1968) is a Chinese chemist specializing in [[organic chemistry]].

==Early life==
Wu was born in 1968 in [[Qinzhou District]] of [[Tianshui]], [[Gansu]] into a [[Hui people|Hui]] family.<ref>{{cite news|author1=Peng Xiaojiao ({{lang|zh|彭晓姣}})|url=http://gansu.gscn.com.cn/system/2019/11/25/012271511.shtml |script-title=zh:天水籍科学家吴骊珠当选中科院院士 |work=gscn.com.cn |date=25 November 2019 |accessdate=26 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref><ref name="elephant">{{cite news|url=https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_5047680 |script-title=zh:喜讯！天水首位女院士吴骊珠诞生 |work=thepaper |date=23 November 2019 |accessdate=26 November 2019 |language=zh}}</ref> Her father Wu Jiantao ({{lang|zh|吴剑涛}}) and mother Ma Xian'e ({{lang|zh|马先娥}}) were a professors at [[Northwest University for Nationalities]].<ref name="elephant"/> Her grandfather Wu Hongjian ({{lang|zh|吴鸿健}}) was a member of the [[China Democratic League]] and vice chairman of the Tianshui Committee of the [[Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference]].<ref name="elephant"/> Her great-uncle Wu Hongbin ({{lang|zh|吴鸿宾}}) was mayor of Tianshui, vice chairman of the Standing Committee of Gansu Provincial People's Congress and executive vice chairman of Gansu Provincial Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference.<ref name="elephant"/>

==Education==
She received her [[Bachelor of Science]] degree in 1990 at [[Lanzhou University]] and completed his doctoral work in 1995 at the Institute of Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences under the supervision of {{ill|Tong Zhenhe|zh|佟振合}}.<ref name="dog"/> After graduation, she worked there, becoming associate research fellow in 1996 and research fellow in 1998.<ref name="dog"/> From 1997 to 1998 she was a postdoc at the [[University of Hong Kong]] under the supervision of [[Chi-Ming Che]].<ref name="dog">{{cite news |author1=Zhao Chenxi |title=Wu Lizhu |url=http://www.womenofchina.cn/womenofchina/html1/special/12/6215-1.htm |accessdate=26 November 2019 |work=womenofchina |date=2011}}</ref>

==Career==
She is now a researcher and doctoral supervisor at the Technical [[Institute of Physics]] and Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS).<ref name="dog"/>

==Honours and awards==
* 2001 Distinguished Young Scholar by the National Science Fund 
* 2010 The 7th China Young Female Scientist Award<ref name="dog"/>
* 2011 Li Yuehua Outstanding Instructor Award
* November 22, 2019 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS)
